title: If I have a fabric swatch, can it be simulated in CLO?
content: **Question** If I have a fabric swatch, can it be simulated in CLO? **Answer** To accurately simulate your fabric swatch in CLO, you need CLO's Fabric Kit or FDS which needs additional charges. However, Fabric Kit and FDS (Fabric Digitization Service) are ancillary services provided only to companies. The company must be qualified for CLO Business plan (One-person company is not eligible for using the FDS service and Fabric Kit). On the other hand, CLO does provide some emulated fabrics as default assets and you can purchase other varieties of free emulated fabrics in [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) which can be modified as needed. Please refer to the manual to learn how to edit [fabric properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000716127-Fabric-Properties-) in CLO. Please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact) if you would like to purchase the Fabric Kit and use the FDS service,
content_description: This webpage provides essential information on simulating fabric swatches in CLO, including the availability of the Fabric Kit and Fabric Digitization Service for qualified companies, as well as options for using default and emulated fabrics.

title: How much is the Fabric kit?
content: **Question** How much is the Fabric kit? **Answer** A Fabric kit is an ancillary service provided only to companies that purchased CLO for Business. The company must purchase the Business license before ordering a fabric kit. Please reach out to CLO via [Contact Us](http://clo3d.com/contact). For additional fabric inventory, we recommend you explore [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/).
content_description: This web page provides information on the availability and purchasing requirements for the Fabric kit offered exclusively to CLO for Business license holders.

title: If I understand correctly, the Stress Map displays the effect the Avatar has on the Pattern, not the effect the Pattern has on the Avatar. Why did you guys choose this method?
content: **Question** If I understand correctly, the Stress Map displays the effect the Avatar has on the Pattern, not the effect the Pattern has on the Avatar. Why did you guys choose this method? **Answer** There are many limitations to the Avatar technologies that are available at the moment (muscle and skin deformation are not taken into account, for example), so any calculations on the effect of Pattern on Avatar would not only be difficult but would be inaccurate.
content_description: This web page aims to clarify the rationale behind the Stress Map's focus on the Avatar's impact on the Pattern, addressing limitations of current Avatar technologies.

content_description: This web page provides information on the compatibility of our CAD software with other 2D CAD programs, highlighting the ability to import and export patterns using DXF-AAMA or ASTM file formats.

title: How long does it take to make virtual fabric using actual fabric?
content: **Question** How long does it take to make virtual fabric using actual fabric? **Answer** It takes about 15 ~20 minutes to create a virtual fabric, performing following three steps: 1. cutting fabric samples, 2. testing fabrics, 3. calculating measurements from the test.
content_description: Discover the quick and efficient process of creating virtual fabric from actual fabric in just 15 to 20 minutes through simple, structured steps.

title: How accurate are virtual fabrics?
content: **Question** How accurate are virtual fabrics? **Answer** There are two ways to emulate fabric properties in CLO as below. To learn more how each method works, please select the desired option. Use Fabrics in CLO Library Create with Fabric Kit All Fabrics provided in the CLO Library and Fabrics created with the Fabric Kit **have 90% of accuracy**. However, the accuracy may differ when Fabrics' Physical Properties are arbitrarily modified. **Use Fabrics in CLO Library** Navigate to the Fabric folder in the CLO Library to use Fabrics come with CLO. Those Fabrics are emulated with the Fabric kit, measuring Stretch, Bending and other Physical Properties and are about 90% accurate. **Create with Fabric Kit** If you would like to emulate own fabrics by measuring their Stretch, Bending and others, you may purchase CLO Fabric Kit. If you are interested in purchasing CLO Fabric Kit, please contact the [CLO Global Support Team](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Discover how to achieve 90% accuracy in fabric emulation using CLO's library and Fabric Kit, with options for both pre-made and custom fabric creation.

title: How can I check my computer specification?
content: **Question** How can I check my computer specification? **Answer** To check your computer specification, please follow the guideline below: 1. Press the Windows + R keys on your keyboard simultaneously, and type "dxdiag" without the quotes. 2. Press the Enter key or click the 'OK' button. 3. Choose 'Save All Information' at the bottom of the window. 4. Save it as a text file.
content_description: Learn how to easily check your computer specifications using the built-in DirectX Diagnostic Tool.

title: I get an error message saying, "H0007 Sentinel HSAP not found." How should I solve the problem?
content: **Question** I get an error message saying "H0007 Sentinel HSAP not found." How should I solve the problem? **Answer** This issue often occurs when the program cannot find the dongle key for authentication. Please refer to the [manual](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000615488#Click3) to learn how to solve the issue in detail.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on resolving the "H0007 Sentinel HSAP not found" error by addressing dongle key authentication issues.

title: Do I need to configure my firewall to use CLO?
content: **Question** Do I need to configure my firewall to use CLO? **Answer** As long as you are connected to an internet, you can use CLO without configuring firewall. If you are using CLO for Enterprise and need to configure firewall due to company protocols, please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact).
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on whether firewall configuration is necessary for using CLO, clarifying that internet connectivity is typically sufficient unless company protocols require specific adjustments.

title: Do I need to know 3D modeling in order to use CLO?
content: **Question** Do I need to know 3D modeling in order to use CLO? **Answer** No, CLO does not require any 3D modeling skills or any 3D software experience. However, prior experience with 3D software may increase your learning speed.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to inform users that CLO can be used without prior 3D modeling skills, while noting that such experience may enhance the learning process.

content_description: This webpage provides information regarding the availability of a Linux version of CLO and invites users to submit requests for future development consideration.

title: Review Mode: How to use the Review data which saved in version 6.1 be used in version 6.2?
content: ## **Question** Are the Review Mode data (3D status info) saved in version 6.1 or earlier compatible with version 6.2? ## **Answer** From version 6.2, the simulation results by size have been improved to be applied directly to the review mode. Therefore, the 3D status info for the Review saved in version 6.1 or lower version is not compatible, and you need to re-simulate for each size. See below video also.
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify the compatibility of Review Mode data between versions 6.1 and 6.2, highlighting the need for re-simulation due to improvements in simulation results.

title: Although my hardware has more than 4 CPU Cores, CLO is not as fast as I expected.
content: **Question** Although my hardware has more than 4 CPU cores, CLO is not as fast as I expected. **Answer** CLO's program speed increases with faster Core clock speed and more Cores. However, there is NO significant speed advancement when there are more than 4 Cores compared to the program speed ran with four Cores. Therefore, to be cost-effective, we recommend hardware with four Cores, each Core's speed being between 3.5 ~4.0 Ghz or faster.
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify the relationship between CPU core count and performance in CLO, recommending optimal hardware specifications for cost-effective efficiency.

title: Can I receive my invoice?
content: **Question** Can I receive my invoice? **Answer** Yes, you can check and print out your invoice from the CLO website. To check your invoice, 1. Go to your [Billing page](https://www.clo3d.com/es/accounts/billing) and click the "Billing Details" button. 2. Click the "Invoice" button according to your subscription. 3. Click the "Print" symbol to print out or download your invoice.
content_description: This page provides a step-by-step guide on how to access and print your invoice from the CLO website.

title: How can I report a bug?
content: **Question** How can I report a bug? **Answer** You can directly report your bug issue to our technical support team via Contact Us. Please follow the steps below: 1. Please go to our [Technical Support form. ](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/technical) 2. Choose your User Type 3. Fill in the required information accordingly. 4. Elaborate on your issues such as a bug, crash, and any technical error. 5. Attach the screenshot or recorded video of your issue for clarification. 6. Click the "Submit" button. Once your issue is submitted, our technical team might solve it or request more information according to the issue.
